task_description: Make IQ Study use Grok (xAI) as its real LLM provider instead of the deterministic mock, so analysis, exam questions, and study prompts produce coherent, on-topic, book-grounded output. Add an OpenAI-compatible XAIProvider (baseURL https://api.x.ai/v1) reading XAI_API_KEY, wire it into getLLMProvider() (support LLM_PROVIDER=xai and auto-select when XAI_API_KEY present), tighten the analyze/question prompts for grounded output while preserving all zod contracts, add keyless unit tests, and document XAI_API_KEY / LLM_PROVIDER=xai / XAI_MODEL in .env.example and README. Everything stays keyless-green with the mock fallback; no API key is hardcoded.
